description: flow/pipeline.py dispatches stages with a hardcoded if/elif chain and GitHub PR/CI consumers lack a typed GitForge Protocol abstraction.
goal: Replace the hardcoded if/elif stage dispatch in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/pipeline.py with a declarative stage registry mapping FlowStage keys to stage handlers (keeping pipeline.py at or below 394 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json). Define a typing.Protocol GitForge in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/forge.py covering GitHubAdapter methods, have GitHubAdapter in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/adapter.py conform to GitForge, and type PR/CI adapter consumers (flow/github/pr.py, flow/github/ci.py, flow/github/ci_final_head_seams.py, flow/github/ci_head_reruns.py, flow/github/ci_timing_rerun.py, flow/github/review_post.py, flow/github/merge.py, and flow/review/loop.py) against GitForge without breaking existing callers. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_pipeline_registry.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_forge_protocol.py verifying declarative stage dispatch and GitForge structural typing, and run uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Replacing inline stage branching with a registry table and decoupling forge calls behind a structural Protocol simplifies stage extensions and isolated testing without touching runner config tables.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline stage dispatch in flow/pipeline.py uses a registry table and PR/CI consumers type against GitForge (structural Protocol in flow/github/forge.py implemented by GitHubAdapter in flow/github/adapter.py).

apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_pipeline_registry.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_forge_protocol.py pass uv run pytest and uv run task lint without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.

PR/CI adapter consumers in `flow/github/pr.py`, `flow/github/ci.py`, `flow/github/ci_final_head_seams.py`, `flow/github/ci_head_reruns.py`, `flow/github/ci_timing_rerun.py`, `flow/github/review_post.py`, `flow/github/merge.py`, and `flow/review/loop.py` type against `GitForge` without breaking existing callers.
